card.name: Visual inspection of injectable products
card.fires_on: The word "visually" (or the product name just before it) in the instruction "Inspect [injection/parenteral drug products] visually for particulate matter and discoloration". It is strongest on "visually".

modes.label: Inspect ... visually
modes.description: The word "visually" after "Inspect" plus a drug or product name, in preparation instructions.
modes.example: Inspect parenteral drug products<< visually>> for particulate matter and discoloration

modes.label: Product noun before visually
modes.description: The product word right before "visually" in the same inspection sentence.
modes.example: Inspect parenteral drug<< products>> visually for particulate matter and discolor

card.plain: It marks the standard instruction to look at an injection for particles and color change before giving it.
